raw_output: Emily's challenges with her children have progressed over time, involving various issues and emotional struggles. Initially, she was worried about her son George being bullied at school, which affected his behavior and made her feel guilty for not being able to protect him. Later, her son Jerry got in trouble at school for using his phone inappropriately, causing her embarrassment and disappointment. Throughout these challenges, Emily has been managing her stress through therapy, which has helped her develop breathing techniques and express her feelings more constructively. She has also been trying to communicate better with her children and find ways to balance her responsibilities as a mother. Despite the difficulties, Emily has been seeking support from her partner Bob and her therapist, and has been working to maintain a sense of control and balance in her life.
